title: 2017 Prairie, the Armour house, gets its mansard, gable and porch
items: 2017 Prairie, William Armour's house between the Reid and High houses, now stands as its one old photograph shows it: a smooth stone front of two storeys over a high basement, a slate mansard with two gabled dormers and a crest along its top, the south part carried up into a steep gable with a finial, and a porch of two columns carrying a stone balcony before the front door, with barred basement windows either side of the stoop. The gable's two attic windows, the carved dormer pediments and the porch's ring-pierced parapet are still simpler than the picture; the sign-off pass on this block takes those on.
